notes.title: Game Release
notes.content:
[h2]Release[/h2]

Our game is finally [b]released[/b]! 
To celebrate the release, we started a [b]40% discount for 2 weeks[/b], so do not miss your chance to obtain your dream stepsister :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576486/5e38326152af251bdb20bbfe4b8cc8d068dc7b7e.gif[/img]

[h2]Workshop[/h2]

We also want to let you know that our game support [b]workshop for custom voice packs[/b], if you want to know how use the workshop check out our guide here:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3475452111

And to see available workshop voice packs:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3615360/workshop/


We look forward to seeing [b]your voice packs[/b]!

[h2]Contacts[/h2]

If you have any questions or suggestions, contact us at [b]gosdevproduction@gmail.com[/b]

Don't forget to also subscribe to our development group:
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/GosDev

And curatorial group:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GosDev

To make sure you don't miss new releases!
